study: Q1 physics step-size / integrator sensitivity of the frozen-controller ranking
written: 2026-10-31, on HomePC, before any Q1 variant episode was run
source: criterion as preregistered for the cluster experiments (text transcribed verbatim)
change: only MuJoCo model.opt.timestep (and opt.integrator for rk4), set once per worker after env build; sensors, actuators, the 2 ms control tick and limits unchanged

variants.dt5: 5 us, implicitfast (MJCF default; reference, must reproduce stored rows bit for bit)

criterion.statement: The qualitative ranking is step-size-robust if, at each tested step size, (a) and (b) hold.
criterion.a: on kick, the probe crashes fewer times than the SNN in >= 4 of 5 seeds
criterion.b: at x1.5 (turbc15), the SNN has a paired delta vs the probe (paired_report.paired, probe as opponent) with 95% upper bound < 0 in >= 3 of 5 seeds
criterion.descriptive: absolute crash-count drift per arm relative to dt5

budget: ~18 workers; priority dt5 selftest > dt2p5+dt10 on kick and x1.5 > rk4 > nominal; drop rk4 and nominal if total > ~8 h wall
